# Tailors.lk Pro

> Tailors.lk Pro is the all-in-one business OS for tailoring shops in Sri Lanka. Orders, customers, measurements, invoicing, shopfront branding, and customer tracking — built for how tailors actually run their business.

We manage shops that don't happen, orders that slip, and measurements that get lost. Tailors.lk Pro replaces paper books with a simple dashboard: log orders, store measurements, generate invoices, track customers, and publish your own branded shop page.

## What is Tailors.lk Pro?

Tailors.lk Pro is a lightweight, mobile-friendly management tool for tailoring and alterations businesses in Sri Lanka. It centralises order management, measurement vaults, invoicing, and customer tracking in one place. It's designed to be simple enough to learn in minutes and affordable for solo tailors and small shops.

## Key Features

- [Order management](https://pro.tailors.lk/features/order-management/): Create orders, track status updates, and set due dates from one dashboard.
- [Measurement vault](https://pro.tailors.lk/features/measurement-vault/): Store a full measurement profile per customer, re-use it across orders.
- [Invoicing](https://pro.tailors.lk/features/invoicing/): Create and send receipts and invoices.
- [Customer tracking](https://pro.tailors.lk/features/customer-tracking/): Follow up on ready orders and repeat customers.
- [Shop branding](https://pro.tailors.lk/features/shop-branding/): Publish a public branded page for your shop.
